_comment: Demonstrates THRIVE routine habit stacking using the optional behavior_design fields (routine.schema.json v1.1). Three morning routines chained via anchor_routine_id.

context.name: Self Stewardship — Morning Routine Stack
context.scope: Personal morning routines for grounding, movement, and daily planning

routines.label: wake-and-ground
steps: Open blinds before picking up phone
known_failure_modes: Reach for phone before getting out of bed
fallback_options: Minimum viable: sit up and put feet on floor — blinds and coffee can follow within five minutes
If coffee maker fails, hot water kettle is acceptable substitute

behavior_design.implementation_intention: When my alarm goes off, I will sit up and open the blinds before picking up my phone.

routines.label: movement
steps: Walk to the end of the block and back
Play one favorite song during the walk
known_failure_modes: Soreness or low energy after poor sleep
fallback_options: Indoor alternative: five minutes of stretching in the living room
Minimum viable: walk to mailbox and back — still counts as movement

behavior_design.reward: play one song I like during the walk
behavior_design.implementation_intention: After I finish my coffee, I will put on my shoes and walk to the end of the block.

routines.label: planning-review
steps: Write three things to accomplish today
Close planner — no full day scheduling unless time allows
known_failure_modes: Temptation to open email or Slack instead of planner
Over-planning turns three items into a full project list
fallback_options: Voice-memo three priorities if desk is unavailable
Minimum viable: one priority written on a sticky note

behavior_design.implementation_intention: When I get back from my walk, I will open my planner and write three things I want to accomplish today.
